title: GLP-1 drugs fail to help some people lose weight — scientists are on a quest for answers
title_zh: GLP-1药物对部分人无效——科学家正在寻找答案
abstract: Understanding why some people see no benefits from potent anti-obesity medications could lead to new therapies and personalized weight-loss regimens.
abstract_zh: 了解为何部分人对强效抗肥胖药物无效，可能为新疗法和个性化减重方案提供线索
